notes.title: Day 1 patch notes, and thanks!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Wow. What a fun launch, thanks to all of you for picking it up and taking it for a spin. The great news is that our QA process pre-launch seems to have been watertight, with very few reporting bugs despite lots going through..

That said, you found a couple of typos, so we've fixed those... please report any other issues in the pinned dev thread on the game's forum.

Thanks so much for the support, keep those steam reviews coming, they really help our metrics, and tell your friends!

Cheers,

Mike
